timeline.summary: Dilip Buildcon announced that its subsidiary received the appointed date for the ₹2,905 Cr ERCP feeder project from Rajasthan Water Grid Corporation Limited.
Dilip Buildcon Limited’s resolutions passed via e-voting on May 01, 2026, with requisite majority as per the April 01, 2026, Postal Ballot Notice.
Dilip Suryavanshi, as Promoter, declared on April 3, 2026, that no new encumbrances were made by Promoters or Persons in Concert beyond those disclosed in FY2025-26.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,299.81 Cr; net profit to shareholders ₹62.05 Cr.
Dilip Buildcon reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,300 Cr and PAT of ₹124 Cr, alongside an order book of ₹28,830 Cr.
Dilip Buildcon’s Board, led by **Abhishek Shrivastava**, recommended a final dividend of ₹1 per share (10%) for FY2026 on May 14, 2026, pending shareholder approval.
Dilip Buildcon reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,300 Cr and PAT of ₹124 Cr with an order book of ₹28,830 Cr.

Dilip Buildcon Limited shared the audio recording link of its Investor/Analyst conference call on May 14, 2026, at 05:00 PM (IST) for Q4FY26 and FY26 results, signed by **Abhishek Shrivastava** via digital means.
Dilip Buildcon hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for 30-40% standalone revenue growth in FY27 and a net debt-free balance sheet by FY28.
Dilip Buildcon received a ₹268 Cr EPC Letter of Award via DBL-RBL JV for constructing the Ged Barrage in Gujarat.
Dilip Buildcon received a ₹688.23 Cr LOA from NHAI for a 4-lane elevated corridor in Solapur, Maharashtra under HAM mode.
